steps: Copy the immutable native decimal DOCX into this new directory.
Open the copy in native Word, move to document start, use Format > Bullets and Numbering > Customize, set Start at to 0 and confirm.
Native screenshot shows 0., 1., 2.; AX incorrectly still shows 1., 1., 2.
Save DOCX, then Save As Word 97-2004 DOC; save and close the task document.
